description: Parse.ly tracker beacons on p1.parsely.com and p1-irl.parsely.com. The tracker loader on cdn.parsely.com is vendor/parsely.

params.name: idsite
params.description: It is the Parse.ly Site ID. Parse.ly documents it as the site identifier on every collect beacon.
params.fix_hint: Set `idsite` to the Site ID from Parse.ly Support, such as `example.com`.

params.name: url
params.description: It is the page URL. Parse.ly documents it as a full URL, not a relative path.
params.fix_hint: Send the absolute page URL in `url`.

params.name: action
params.description: It names the event. Parse.ly documents `pageview`, `heartbeat`, `videostart`, `vheartbeat`, `conversion`, and `custom`.

params.name: rand
params.description: It is an integer tracker field. Parse.ly documents `rand` / `sts` / `slts` as millisecond timestamps, `plid` / `pvid` / `sid` as ids, and `inc` as heartbeat seconds. `slts` is `0` on a first session.
params.fix_hint: Send an integer, such as `0` or a millisecond timestamp.

params.name: urlref
params.description: It is the HTTP referrer. Parse.ly documents a full URL, or blank when the reader typed the address.
params.fix_hint: Send an absolute referrer URL in `urlref`, or leave it blank.

params.name: sref
params.description: It is the session's first referrer. Parse.ly documents that it can be blank.
params.fix_hint: Send an absolute URL in `sref`, or leave it blank.

params.name: surl
params.description: It is the session's first pageview URL.
params.fix_hint: Send the absolute first-page URL in `surl`.

params.name: screen
params.description: It is the client resolution. Parse.ly documents `WIDTHxHEIGHT|availableWIDTHxavailableHEIGHT|pixelDepth`.

params.name: data
params.description: It is optional JSON. Parse.ly documents conversions, audience segments, and custom data here, and allows a blank value.
params.fix_hint: Send a JSON object in `data`, or leave it blank.

params.name: title
params.description: It is the content title shown in the Parse.ly dashboard.
params.fix_hint: Send the headline in `title`, or drop the empty pair.

params.name: date
params.description: It is the client-side event time. Parse.ly documents an ISO 8601 datetime string.

params.name: u
params.description: It is the pseudonymous device UUID.
params.fix_hint: Send the device UUID in `u`, or drop the empty pair.
